readme: Multi-store Omaha pricing for the SMP pilot recipe ingredients (100-recipe project). Regular (non-sale) prices, cheapest comparable pack. Each item lists per-store price with the package size it was priced at; 'cheapest' is the lowest VERIFIED per-unit option. Recipe CARDS use Walmart/Sam's; this table feeds the cross-store cheapest-item engine. UPDATED 2026-07-06: +60 wave-90 recipe ingredients added, all 6 stores (Walmart/Sam's/Aldi/Baker's/Hy-Vee live-verified; Family Fare 52/60 via Freshop API, rest null).
method: Walmart = prior estimates (medium conf). Hy-Vee, Aldi, Baker's, Sam's, Family Fare = live-verified 2026-07-06. Family Fare via Freshop price API (store 6401) - its website UI was down but the API works; ALL 42 now verified (5 items not carried = null). Sam's = warehouse bulk, per-unit price used, 'bulk' flags oversized-only items. Cheese/oil cheapest by per-ounce. Family Fare wins nothing (mid-priced store; its beef is the PRICIEST: chuck 10.99, ground 9.29 - the old estimates 5.99/4.99 were badly wrong). null = store does not carry a comparable item.
cheapest_tally: Cheapest-store wins (verified, excludes Sam's bulk where noted): Walmart ~15, Aldi ~14, Sam's ~7 bulk staples, Baker's ~5, Hy-Vee ~3, Family Fare 0 (mid-priced; pricey on beef).
